scheme_name: Hari Om Ashram Prerit Doctor Vikram Sarabhai Research Award
description:
The Hari Om Ashram Prerit Doctor Vikram Sarabhai Research Award is a prestigious initiative launched by the Government of India to honor the legacy of Dr. Vikram Sarabhai. 

Dr. Vikram Sarabhai is widely recognized as the father of the Indian space program. 

He was instrumental in establishing the Indian National Committee for Space Research in 1962. 

The award was instituted in 1971 by the Hari Om Ashram Trust. 

The primary objective of this award is to promote research in the field of space science and technology. 

It aims to encourage young scientists and researchers to contribute to the advancement of space research in India. 

The award is presented annually to outstanding researchers in the field of space science. 

The award recognizes exceptional contributions that align with the vision of Dr. Vikram Sarabhai. 

The award includes a cash prize of INR 1,00,000. 

In addition to the cash prize, recipients receive a citation and a medal. 

The award is open to researchers who are Indian citizens. 

Eligible candidates must be below the age of 35 years at the time of application. 

This age limit is strictly enforced to encourage young talent in the field. 

Candidates must have a Ph.D. in a relevant field of space science or technology. 

Research work must be original and should have been published in a recognized journal. 

The application process for the award requires candidates to submit their research papers. 

Applicants must also provide a detailed curriculum vitae. 

A recommendation letter from a recognized authority in the field is also mandatory. 

The applications are reviewed by a committee of experts in the field of space science. 

The committee evaluates the submissions based on originality, significance, and impact. 

The award ceremony is typically held in the month of December each year. 

The specific date for the award ceremony is announced on the official website of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO). 

The award is administered by the ISRO, which is the implementing authority. 

ISRO is headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka. 

The contact details for ISRO can be found on their official website. 

The award serves to inspire the next generation of scientists in India. 

It emphasizes the importance of research in the development of space technology. 

The award also promotes collaboration among researchers across various institutions. 

Since its inception, the award has recognized numerous talented individuals. 

These individuals have made significant contributions to the field of space science. 

The award has played a crucial role in fostering innovation and excellence in research. 

It has also contributed to India's standing in the global space community. 

The award is part of a broader initiative by the Indian government to promote scientific research. 

This initiative aligns with the country's goal of becoming a global leader in space technology. 

The award has seen participation from various prestigious institutions across India. 

These institutions include the Indian Institute of Science and various IITs. 

The award encourages interdisciplinary research that combines space science with other fields. 

This includes applications in communication, meteorology, and environmental studies. 

The award has a significant impact on the careers of young researchers. 

It provides recognition that can lead to further opportunities in academia and industry. 

The award also enhances the visibility of the recipients' work. 

This visibility can attract funding and collaboration opportunities. 

The award is a testament to the commitment of the Indian government to support scientific research. 

It reflects the vision of Dr. Vikram Sarabhai for a self-reliant and technologically advanced India. 

The award has evolved over the years to adapt to changing scientific landscapes. 

It continues to attract high-quality research contributions from young scientists. 

The award is a source of pride for the recipients and their affiliated institutions. 

It symbolizes the importance of dedication and hard work in the pursuit of knowledge. 

The Hari Om Ashram Prerit Doctor Vikram Sarabhai Research Award is a significant milestone in India's journey in space exploration. 

It serves as a reminder of the potential of young minds to shape the future of science and technology. 

The award not only honors Dr. Sarabhai's legacy but also inspires future generations. 

In conclusion, the Hari Om Ashram Prerit Doctor Vikram Sarabhai Research Award is a vital initiative. 

It plays a crucial role in promoting research in space science and technology in India. 

The award encourages young researchers to strive for excellence and innovation. 

It is a beacon of hope for aspiring scientists across the nation. 

The award continues to uphold the values and vision of one of India's greatest scientists. 

This initiative is an essential part of India's scientific ecosystem. 

It fosters a culture of research and development that is critical for national progress.

It serves as an enduring inspiration for future generations of scientists.
